lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular vertical arrangement of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits. Spots increase in diameter and spacing moving towards the posterior, forming roughly linear vertical groupings of two to four nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, creating a grid-like pattern where the blobs act as vertices within the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally across the flank. The most distinct ridge displays a sharp luminance contrast—bright on the superior edge and shadowed on the inferior edge—running parallel to the lateral line.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct fusiform silhouettes (commensal organisms) are visible attached or swimming in close proximity to the ventral-posterior region of the pectoral fin.
